data.text: Colour is never the only channel on an exported chart. Three of the eight categorical slots sit below 3:1 against white, and a band that collapses to zero puts two slots side by side that the palette never promised to separate - so every chart ships a legend, a table of the rows it was drawn from, and direct labels on the bands wide enough to carry them. The hover layer is an SVG <title> per mark: a native tooltip, no script.
